about: Measured VST-parameter -> FM8E payload mapping for FM8 1.7.x. Probe: load default chunk, set one parameter, re-read, decompress the FastLZ block, diff the FM8E payload. Derived from measurements on the author's own installed copy; contains no Native Instruments code or data.
notes: offset is the first byte of the parameter field in the FM8E payload
width 4 fields are LE float32 storing the VST value directly (or a scaled copy)
width 1..3 fields are engine-domain integers, see data/param_curves.json
shared flag bytes 0x484..0x48c are excluded (derived from 4 params each)
